scope: Current public Poczta Polska System PNA pages, sales terms, July 2026 PDF, public search contract and one non-personal 00-940 lookup plus GUGiK PRG/WFS public descriptions were audited without contacting a provider, registering, authenticating, accepting terms, purchasing data, querying personal/private property/customer/shipment rows, or creating a repository or publication destination.

countryIdentity.rule: Poland retains repository PL. Administrative, address and postal identities remain separate and no source region is merged or reassigned.

m2Definition.definition: A current complete Poczta Polska PNA assignment and exception denominator is usable under explicit reviewed permission for AGID processing, derivation, storage, redistribution and public serving, and is reconciled to a fixed authoritative Poland postal-code Polygon/MultiPolygon release. Edition, reference date, provider, licence, attribution, byte length, SHA-256, schema, source CRS, reviewed transform, topology, coverage, exclusions and reproducible conversion are fixed in an approved immutable artifact. The real PL API/app normalizes NN-NNN, returns only valid real areas, fits and renders translucent fill with a clear outline, and shows selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence; organization, route, P.O.-box, point, membership-only and unmatched codes remain explicit non-areas and no administrative, address, building, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster or synthetic proxy satisfies M2.

officialObservations.finding: Poczta defines PNA as five digits written NN-NNN, states that it owns System PNA economic copyrights, derives the official list from postal delivery units and GUS TERYT context, and sells PDF/XLS/TXT electronic lists with quarterly updates for limited customer use.
Terms effective 2023-11-01 describe controlled access and quarterly updates. No permission compatible with AGID derivation, database storage, redistribution and public serving was established.

The exact 1,786-page July 2026 PDF is encrypted against copying and states all rights reserved, prohibiting reproduction, electronic/mechanical processing, other-publication use and database storage without written consent. Full deterministic text inspection found 121,627 PNA occurrences, 21,642 distinct values and no geometry terms.

The public database reported update 2026-08-30 and uses a POST search contract. One non-personal 00-940 lookup returned six rows with PNA, name, locality, address, voivodeship, district and commune fields and no geometry tokens.

GUGiK describes official reusable administrative boundaries and address/location context current for 2026. This is not an advertised PNA postcode-area authority and cannot substitute for a postal polygon.

The public service description lists administrative and address/street services. Four www.geoportal.gov.pl page requests and two mapy.geoportal.gov.pl WFS capability requests timed out over IPv4 HTTPS in this environment; availability failure is not proof of dataset non-existence.

rightsAssessment.note: Public availability and individual search access are not treated as a licence. This is a conservative engineering gate, not a legal opinion.

browserReview.reason: No approved fixed authoritative Poland PNA area artifact exists. The 00-940 rows, administrative geometry and synthetic fixtures were not staged as a false postal area.

pdfVisualReview.reason: The local image viewer returned Windows error 206 for both original and shortened paths. Rights text was verified through exact-body hashing, pdfinfo and deterministic text extraction; no visual-inspection claim is made.

reportPresentation.reason: The exact table communicates the decisive rights, current-list and zero-authoritative-geometry gates more accurately than a chart.

blockerSummary: The current July 2026 official PNA PDF and 2026-08-30 public search are strong operator references, but Poczta's copyright and controlled-list terms do not establish permission for AGID processing, derivation, database storage, redistribution or public serving. Neither source contains postal-area geometry. GUGiK PRG/address sources are separate administrative/address authorities, and no fixed authoritative PNA Polygon/MultiPolygon release, digest, topology/coverage audit or complete assignment-to-area/non-area reconciliation was established. No real PL runtime/API/UI artifact can therefore pass.
unblockConditions: Obtain explicit reviewed Poczta permission for AGID processing, derivation, storage, reconciliation, redistribution and public serving, or an equivalent expressly open current complete assignment/exception release.

Obtain a fixed authoritative Poland postcode-area Polygon/MultiPolygon release and pin provider, edition, reference date, licence, attribution, byte length, SHA-256, schema, source CRS, reviewed transform, coverage and exclusions.

Validate every geometry and reconcile the complete current assignment/exception denominator to an exact authoritative area or explicit reasoned non-area while inventing no administrative, address, building, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster or synthetic proxy.
Build an approved immutable artifact and pass real PL loader, API, normalization, geometry validity, map fit, translucent fill, outline, provenance, clear and re-search verification.
